overall: Atlanta sits at 75.2°F as of 07:19 ET under fully overcast skies (OVC, ceiling ~274m/900ft) with a very high dewpoint of 71.6°F — conditions that are suppressing early-morning warming and keeping the running max at just 77.0°F.
